description: List the task templates available in a Workspace, paginated. Returns each template's id and name. Use to discover a `template_id` before creating a task from a template.

page.description: 0-based page number for pagination. Defaults to 0 (first page).

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: get_task_templates
